snippet.title: Donkey Kong Bananza – Nintendo Direct | Nintendo Switch 2
snippet.description:
Donkey Kong Bananza is coming exclusively to Nintendo Switch 2 on July 17, 2025! Pre-order today: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/donkey-kong-bananza-switch-2/?utm_source=SW-AAA&utm_medium=soytnoa&utm_campaign=S1003-01&utm_id=S1003-01

Explore a vast underground world—by smashing your way through it! Bash, throw, and climb through just about anything in DK’s brand-new 3D platforming action-adventure game!

Watch more Donkey Kong Bananza gameplay from Nintendo Treehouse: Live | Nintendo Switch 2:
➤ https://youtu.be/LOvkfpenFtg
➤ https://youtu.be/bG2u334HfFc
➤ https://youtu.be/Z6faq_QW_U8

Visit Nintendo.com for more info: https://ninten.do/6008Spp2s
